title: WhyKit optional claim provenance payload
description: Producer-owned payload, not vault front matter or a CLI report. Structural schema only: validate_claim also checks ordered byte offsets, UTF-8 encoding and quote byte length. verify_anchor checks supplied source bytes. Neither establishes truth, identity or authorization.

links.description: An explicit empty list means no evidence link has been supplied, not that the statement is false. Multiple assessments of the same anchor may coexist; no semantic verdict is inferred.

source_version.description: SHA-256 of the exact original bytes, with no BOM, newline or Unicode normalization. A content digest is not source identity.

location.description: Zero-based byte offsets, end exclusive; the quote is UTF-8 encoded and must match exactly. validate_claim requires start < end and matching quote byte length.

assessment.description: Producer-declared semantic assessment and attribution; human is not authenticated review and model cannot become human by matching source bytes.
